title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,606,400 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
summary: The number includes 2,290 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

title: Zelensky says more SBU personnel decisions coming after senior officials dismissed over criminal gang involvement
summary: "Unfortunately, this week brought very different news about the SBU – frankly, disturbing, truly disgraceful, absolutely unacceptable things," President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

title: Senator Blumenthal to introduce legislation supporting Ukraine, calls for new US negotiators, Starlink controls
summary: "Trump needs new negotiators—not fawning pawns who call this brutal murderer a 'humanitarian.' Congress must lead without delay," Sen. Richard Blumenthal said.

title: Zelensky tasks PM with creating free transportation program in Kyiv as Russia's bridge attacks hinder travel
summary: According to the president's advisor, Dmytro Lytvyn, the plan's details could be presented as soon as tomorrow.

title: 3 people, including child, die in Kyiv Oblast from improperly running generator as Russia slams power grids across Ukraine
summary: The State Emergency Service said the victims died of carbon monoxide poisoning because they ran the generator in the basement instead of outside, at a safe distance. Another child in the home was hospitalized following the incident.

title: Why this South African decided to build a life in Ukraine — and document it
summary: Kyiv-based South African tech entrepreneur and filmmaker Ronnie Apteker discusses Ukraine’s image abroad, persistent stereotypes, war fatigue, and the importance of telling stories that show Ukrainians as people building businesses, raising families, and creating despite the war.

title: Europe to participate in Abu Dhabi peace talks, French foreign minister says
summary: "The Europeans will be well represented, and France will be in Abu Dhabi to take part in these discussions. I cannot yet tell you who will represent France on this occasion, but it will certainly be there," French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot  said.

title: Russia to replace Norway in ice hockey championship as more countries vow to boycott games
summary: In the new layout of the 2027 World Junior Hockey Championship, which is due to take place in Canada from Dec. 26, 2026, to Jan. 5, 2027, Russia will place tenth. As the lowest-ranked team, Norway will move down to Division 1A.

title: Moscow police detain over 200 people, reportedly forcing some to sign military contracts
summary: Detainees told the Russian Telegram channel "Ostorozhno, Novosti" that those over the age of 18 were "persistently" urged to sign a contract with Russia's Defense Ministry. Reports of police beating the detainees, smashing their phones, and prohibiting them from using the toilet later emerged.

title: Russian attacks kill 7, injure 19 in Ukraine over the past day, striking Zaporizhzhia Oblast over 700 times
summary: Russian forces carried out 725 strikes on 53 settlements in Zaporizhzhia Oblast alone, injuring one person, Governor Ivan Fedorov said.

title: Ukrainian drones hit key bridge, power stations in Russia's Rostov Oblast, governor says
summary: Drone debris reportedly damaged the bridge over the Mius River, located on the R-280 highway — a strategic road that links Rostov Oblast with several Russian-occupied regions in Ukraine, including Crimea.
